recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. If current TestScript URL semantics need further adjustment, make that change in the external FHIR testing IG/source that now owns the testing resources rather than reintroducing TestScript source into core.
issue_request: FHIR-38748 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested URL support for TestScript origins and destinations. The accepted first-comment scope added TestScript.origin.url and TestScript.destination.url and did not add separate URL-typed operation.origin or operation.destination elements.
initial_application: Git commit 8297a4b1066627244b16be453b8aaa211e4f5c5b applied the issue by adding TestScript.origin.url and TestScript.destination.url to source/testscript/structuredefinition-TestScript.xml and by adding an example destination URL to testscript-example-multisystem.xml.
additional_context: Later applied issue FHIR-46100 replaced TestScript.origin and TestScript.destination with TestScript.testSystem. The last core TestScript source before removal retained URL support as TestScript.testSystem.url, with operation.origin and operation.destination still referring to test-system indices. Commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 then removed the TestScript/TestPlan/TestReport source trees and active fhir.ini resource entries from core and added an external testing IG link.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The requested R5 change was applied in history, the later TestScript model preserved URL support before removal, and current source/fhir.ini has no active TestScript source in the core build.

related_jiras.note: Replaced TestScript.origin and TestScript.destination with TestScript.testSystem while retaining URL support as TestScript.testSystem.url.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue requesting URL support for TestScript.origin and TestScript.destination, with the accepted first-comment scope adding only those two URL elements.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final work-group request and that separate URL-typed operation.origin/operation.destination elements were not part of the accepted application.

evidence_items.locator: #fhir/infrastructure-wg > TestScript.origin and destination should support URLs
evidence_items.summary: The reporter explained the need to specify origins and destinations by URL string, and Richard Ettema responded that he agreed it was a good enhancement after reviewing the Jira.
evidence_items.learned: The community discussion supports the Jira rationale and does not add a conflicting or broader final decision.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes record FHIR-38748 as Persuasive with Richard Ettema/Gino Canessa 14-0-0.
evidence_items.learned: The meeting record confirms the vote behind the Jira disposition.

evidence_items.summary: Commit 'FHIR-38748 TestScript.origin and TestScript.destination should support urls' added origin.url, destination.url, and an example URL.
evidence_items.learned: The requested R5 source change was actually applied in core history.

evidence_items.summary: After FHIR-46100, the last core TestScript definition had TestScript.testSystem.url as an explicit URL path for the test system and operation.origin/destination referred to testSystem indices.
evidence_items.learned: Later applied source preserved the URL capability under the successor TestScript model before core removal.

evidence_items.summary: Current fhir.ini has [additional-ig-list] testing=https://build.fhir.org/ig/hl7/fhir-testing-ig/index.html and no active testscript resource entry; commit f9a44787c4 deleted the TestScript source tree.
evidence_items.learned: TestScript is outside the current core build scope, so the correct core action is an external-repo audit rather than a source edit.
